setup_common:
set -euo pipefail
git init -q --bare -b main origin.git
git init -q -b main app
cd app
git config user.name "Test Owner"
git config user.email owner@example.com
printf 'import sys


def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}."


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(greet(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "world"))
' > greet.py
printf 'import unittest

from greet import greet


class GreetTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_greets_by_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(greet("Ann"), "Hello, Ann.")
' > test_greet.py
printf 'test:
	python3 -m unittest -q
' > Makefile
printf '__pycache__/
' > .gitignore
printf 'Load the `git` skill before working in a git repository.
' > AGENTS.md
git add -A
git commit -qm "feat: greet by name"
git remote add origin ../origin.git
git push -qu origin main

evals.name: latest-commit
evals.prompt: /git:amend fold the README typo fix into the commit that added the README
evals.baseline_prompt: Fold the README typo fix into the commit that added the README.
evals.setup:
git switch -q -c feat/shout && printf 'import sys


def greet(name, shout=False):
    text = f"Hello, {name}."
    return text.upper() if shout else text


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a != "--shout"]
    print(greet(args[0] if args else "world", "--shout" in sys.argv))
' > greet.py && printf '
    def test_shouts(self):
        self.assertEqual(greet("Ann", shout=True), "HELLO, ANN.")
' >> test_greet.py && git add -A && git commit -qm 'feat: add --shout' && printf 'Helo, this greets people.
' > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm 'docs: add a README' && sed -i '' 's/Helo/Hello/' README.md
evals.expected_output: The fix is folded into the latest commit: still two commits, same subjects, README fixed, clean tree.
expectations: the branch still has exactly two commits
the latest commit's README is fixed
checks: [ "$(git log --format=%s main..HEAD | tr "\n" "|")" = "docs: add a README|feat: add --shout|" ]
git show HEAD:README.md | grep -q Hello && ! git show HEAD:README.md | grep -q Helo

evals.expected_output: The fix is folded into the older README commit with a fixup and autosquash rebase: still two commits, same order, README fixed in the first.

evals.setup: printf 'Helo, this greets people.\n' > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm 'docs: add a README' && git push -q && git rev-parse HEAD > ../orig && sed -i '' 's/Helo/Hello/' README.md
